column5: THE ONE BLOCK THIS ROW HAS BEEN OPEN ON SINCE WAVE 51 IS BUILT. Read live 2026-09-22 with get_metadata on `Simple Chart line` 11998:249793, get_design_context on `Nav of chart` 11998:249794 and on the first grid row `Frame 1019` 11998:249838, and confirmed against a render - which mattered, because the layer name says line chart and the frame draws a HEAT MAP, so a metadata-only reading would have described the wrong component coherently. GEOMETRY, off the node. The block is 708x375 with its children on a 16 inset, and it closes: 16 + 42 + 16 + 255 + 16 + 14 + 16 = 375. `Nav of chart` 676x42 at (16,16) carries "Average gas prices" in Manrope 14/18 -0.56 white over a 6 gap, then the strap in the same face on App/Ash 300 #95a09f; its right column `Frame 1033` 11998:249809 is 182 wide - five 34x6 swatches on a 3 gap, 8 clear, then five 36x14 labels in Mulish 12/14 -0.48 white at 64% reading 10/8/6/4/2. `Frame 1015` 11998:249827 is 676x255 at (16,74): a 39-wide day column Mon..Sun, 10 clear, then `Frame 1026` 11998:249837 - seven rows of SEVENTEEN 34x34 cells on a flat 3 gap, so a 37 pitch both ways (16x37+34 = 626 across, 6x37+34 = 256 down), no corner radius. `Frame 1014` 11998:249975 is 621x14 at (71,345): twelve 50-wide month labels on a 51.909 pitch. THREE THINGS THE CARRIED NOTE DID NOT HAVE, each measured here. (1) The month axis is TWELVE labels and the tenth reads "2027" - the board writes the YEAR where January would sit, so the list is its text and not a month sequence with a typo. (2) A hover readout is drawn, `Frame 463` 11998:249964, reading "Hour 15 / Rei 0.22 / 2 November, 2026"; it corroborates gasUnit.ts:9, which already recorded "the heat map readout is Rei 0.22" from an independent pass. (3) The legend's floor swatch is Sky Blue #56c7f3 at alpha 0.24 and its steps are 1 / 0.64 / 0.44 / 0.34 / 0.24 - so the bottom of the ramp is a DRAWN 2 Rei day, not an empty cell. THE BLOCK FILL IS MEASURED, NOT GUESSED: #001615, sampled off the render, and a 0.24 cell over it computes to the #15414A the render also shows - the same reading twice. THE CORNER RADIUS IS NOT: every edge and corner pixel returns #001615 at full alpha, which cannot separate a square corner from a radius whose backdrop is the same colour, so the 12 built here is taken from the sibling sections on this page and is named as inferred. NO STROKE ARITHMETIC WAS ATTEMPTED and none is claimed: the 16 inset is measured from the CHILDREN, the node declares no padding this lane could read, and a tail inferred that way balances by construction whatever the stroke does. THE SOURCE CLAIM WAS RE-DERIVED, NOT CARRIED, and it holds: nothing publishes a per-day average gas price. The indexer's protocol-stats payload has no gas field at all, so src/hooks/explorer/useAnalyticsCharts.ts:34-58 hard-codes gasUsed: null and says a full time series "would need an indexer extension"; the chain RPC answers per-block headers, which is where this page's own 20-block base-fee line comes from; skai_* carries no gas method; and public.chain_metrics_history, the one table that ever held a timestamped gas_price, was archived and revoked from anon and authenticated in May 2026. So per Casey's 2026-09-18 direction the grid draws its SHAPE - 7 x 17 cells at 34 on the board's 3 gap - with every cell on a neutral empty fill and the strap naming the missing read in place of the board's own "Estimated heat map value", which is the board calling its own figure estimated. ONE DELIBERATE DEPARTURE FROM THE FRAME, and it is a no-mock finding in visual form: the legend is NOT drawn while the series is offline. A key reading 10/8/6/4/2 Rei beside an uncoloured grid invites the reader to take the empty cells for the scale's floor, and that floor is a real 2 Rei reading, not an absence - the same family as a null coercing to a confident zero. The empty cell is App/Ash 300 at 8%, chosen so it cannot be mistaken for the 0.24 bottom of the blue ramp. The legend returns with the readings. CASEY CALL, NARROWED FROM THREE OPTIONS TO A BINARY AND THE WORK IS DONE EITHER WAY. The page now draws the board's block, and BENEATH it keeps the live 20-block base-fee line, which the board does not draw in that slot. That is the only reason this row is not done: on the board's own state the page renders one block more than the board, always. (a) Delete the kept line for the board's single block - the whole change is removing one motion.div, named in the source comment at GasTrackerPage.tsx; (b) keep both, and this row closes as done with the line named as a kept reading. It is kept for now on the same reasoning wave 55 used for the gas calculator the board crops: an unavailable panel is not a reason to drop a working measurement, and this is the page's only real time series. Unlike Launchpad's and AI's kept sections, which are data-dependent and so vanish on the board's own empty chain, this one draws always - which is why the row says partial rather than borrowing their done. Everything else on this board stands from the wave 55 and wave 60 builds and was not re-derived: the Main container, its 44 band, the 676 table and the 52 pager, and the 43x18 24H CTA in the Standard and Fast tiles that wave 60 read on the node as opacity-0 and the page correctly does not draw. Tests: the new src/pages/explorer/__tests__/gasHeatMap.test.ts is 8 green (row and column counts with the 626/256 arithmetic, the twelve-label axis with the year at January, the five legend alphas, the Offline carrying its source and reason with no third case, the empty fill never being the scale floor, the legend held back while offline, the block box, and the mount order). One of its own assertions was WRONG on first run and is worth the line: it took the table's index off the string "Recent block gas usage", which appears FIRST in BlockGasTable's doc comment, so the order assertion was comparing against a comment - it now matches the section's markup. Neighbours green and unchanged: crumbStandDownGap 20, tileValueFace 27, GasTrackerPage.feeTiles 3. Scoped tsc over the FOUR touched files reports 0 errors in any of them, and all four are proved in-program by --listFiles (GasHeatMap.tsx, components/explorer/index.ts, GasTrackerPage.tsx, gasHeatMap.test.ts); the run's only two diagnostics are environment-level TS2688s for @testing-library/jest-dom and vitest/globals from the shared tsconfig.test.json types array, not file errors. Commit 0d7dafd2b on main, not pushed - Ruling 16; main runs ahead of production, so done here would mean landed, not live.

ONE OF THIS ROW'S TWO OPEN ITEMS IS SETTLED, AND THE CARRIED NOTE IS OVERTURNED ON ITS MECHANISM. Wave 59 and wave 60 both carried it as a bare number: the board draws this page's SECOND pager `Frame 271` 11998:260074 at 54 with a 42 `Frame 988`, against 52 with a 40 on the first section's identical strip and on the shared component, and neither pass said why. Read both instances with get_design_context this pass - 11998:260074 here and the Blocks board's 11998:244882, the same component - and they are byte-for-byte the same box: `bg-[#122524] border-t border-[#123f3c] px-[16px] py-[6px] rounded-b-[12px]`, a `gap-[16px] opacity-64` group, and a page chip at `bg-[#001615] px-[20px] py-[12px] rounded-[8px]`. Identical DECLARED padding on both. THE WHOLE 2px IS THE CHIP LABEL'S TYPE TOKEN, and nothing else. The Blocks chip's text 11998:244889 is Md/Numbers 4 300, Mulish 14/16; the Social chip's 11998:260081 is Lg/Numbers 4 300, Mulish 14/18. So 12 + 16 + 12 = 40 and the strip closes at 6 + 40 + 6 = 52, against 12 + 18 + 12 = 42 and 6 + 42 + 6 = 54. The same swap runs through the rest of that one instance: its range reads Lg/Numbers 5 (12/16) where Blocks reads Md/Numbers 5 (12/14), and its Pages label is Lg/Paragraph 3 where Blocks is Md/Paragraph 2. The Lg family is the 1440 boards' token set, so this is ONE instance on a 768 board wearing the desktop type scale - a FRAME DEFECT on that instance, not a second pager size, and the shipped 52/40 is correct for every 768 explorer board. NO CODE CHANGE, deliberately: the shared ExplorerTablePager.tsx is on `h-[52px]` with an `h-10` group and is right; moving it to 54 to chase this instance would push every explorer page 2 off its own board. THE STROKE, BY ARITHMETIC ON DECLARED PADDING - not on a tail inferred from the leftover, which is why this one is worth stating. Both instances DECLARE `py-[6px]` and carry `border-t`. Blocks sums 6 + 40 + 6 = 52 against a frame that closes at 52: EQUAL, so the stroke is drawn inside and uncounted, and CSS pays (padding - 1) + border on the bordered edge. The shipped component fixes `h-[52px]` with `border-t`, which is that same box, so nothing moves. STILL OPEN, and it is a product binary only Casey can call, unchanged from wave 59: the board SELECTS the Messages tab and the page opens on Copy leaders (SocialPage.tsx:417, `useState("copy-leaders")`). Not flipped here. Copy leaders is the one panel with a live source; the Messages panel is honest but empty - SocialPage.tsx:535-536 states that on-chain messages have no 0x06/0x07 indexer route, so it is an absent source rather than a count of zero. (a) Follow the frame and open on Messages, which makes an absent-source panel the first thing every visitor sees; (b) keep Copy leaders as the default and record the frame's selection as its illustrative state. A default tab is what every visitor sees first, so this lane did not flip it on a standing rule. Everything else on this board stands from wave 59 and wave 60 and was not re-derived, including the tile faces fixed to font-mulish in 8a01a5a7b and the pager chip fill, group opacity and range face corrected in 6b174556d.

TWO SOURCE QUESTIONS THE NEXT PASS MUST SETTLE BEFORE DRAWING ANY OF IT, neither resolved here. (1) FOUR of the board's figures carry a percent-change DELTA (both volume tiles and every one of the six market rows), and no stat on this page carries a delta today; a delta needs a prior-period reading, so whichever read backs each figure has to publish a window or the leg draws unavailable. (2) The six market names are Solana venues - Raydium, Jupiter lend, Pump.fun, Meteora - beside Skai itself, so "Top markets by liquidity" is not obviously a SKAI-chain read at all; name the source before drawing a liquidity table, and do not let the heading assert a chain the figures do not come from.
